title: AAV9 capsid structure (3UX1) -- deposited coordinates, deposited symmetry
source: danon.structure.load_aav9_capsid() over PDB 3UX1; coordinates and REMARK 350 BIOMT operators read from data/pdb/3UX1.pdb
notes: Coordinates are C-alpha only: this is a backbone trace of one deposited model, not an atomic surface.
The 60-subunit assembly is generated from the entry's own REMARK 350 BIOMT matrices -- the depositors' operators, not a reconstruction.
`exposure_proxy` is radius / outer_radius (a radial measure). It is NOT solvent-accessible surface area.
`contacts` counts C-alpha neighbours within 10 A across the assembly -- a contact number, not an energy.
The VR-IV / VR-VIII window boundaries are this repository's design windows; the residues inside them are the deposit's.

data.title: Structural characterization of adeno-associated virus serotype 9
data.method: X-ray / cryo-EM-assisted model of the T=1 capsid
data.reference: DiMattia MA, Nam HJ, Van Vliet K, et al. Structural insight into the unique properties of adeno-associated virus serotype 9. J Virol. 2012;86(12):6947-6958. PDB 3UX1.
data.mislabeled_prior_id_actual: PDB 3J1S is adeno-associated virus 2 in complex with neutralising monoclonal antibody A20 (McCraw DM, O'Donnell JK, Taylor KA, Stagg SM, Chapman MS. J Virol. 2012;86(23):12722-12730) -- serotype 2, not 9.
